text:
Taylor H: Quick status check — kernel throughput milestone update. We're seeing a small number of tail latency spikes in the prod canary after yesterday's batching-window change. Anyone seen this locally? :eyes:
Priya S: I pushed a light probe to canary earlier. Initial traces show a KV cache miss burst causing ~2s outliers on a subset. Looking into root cause now.
Lin C: I reproduced something similar in nightly under high concurrency — continuous batching increased queueing behind the kernel dispatch. Feels like backpressure isn't propagating cleanly across the batching boundary.
Omar R: We bumped `max_batch_delay` 8 -> 16ms yesterday. That could increase headroom but also adds queue buildup. Can we try 10ms and re-run the canary? @Taylor
Taylor H: Good call. @buildbot can you trigger a canary with `max_batch_delay_ms=10` and a shorter KV TTL for this run? Add extra p99 logging please. :thumbsup:
buildbot: deploy triggered — canary group "throughput-gatehouse". Config: {"max_batch_delay_ms":10,"kv_ttl_ms":120000}. CI job #789 queued.
Jen K: I'll monitor the dashboards and be ready to roll back. If this looks worse I can file a revert PR immediately.
Priya S: Early traces from the new canary look better: p95 improved and p99 dropped from ~2.1s -> ~1.4s. Still seeing outliers correlated with sequences >1024 tokens.
Lin C: Large sequences hit a different attention kernel path, which triggers a cache swap/warmup penalty. Two quick ideas: prefetch KV for long sequences, or increase warmup budget on swap-handshake. Prefetch seems lower risk.
Taylor H: Plan: 1) keep `max_batch_delay=10ms` for now, 2) Priya to run a canary with KV-warmup/prefetch enabled for sequences >1024, 3) Lin to prototype a small kernel-handshake tweak to reduce swap penalty. Owners: @Priya, @Lin. Target: validate within 24h.
Omar R: I'll add `batch_queue_length` as an infra metric threshold for auto-rollback and update rollout doc.
Jen K: Filed issue PLAT-4529 with repro steps and traces — link: https://our-issue-tracker/PLAT-4529 :page_facing_up:
Taylor H: Thanks all. If prefetch doesn't fully remove outliers we'll consider reverting the batch-window change. For now marking milestone status = "degraded" and keeping the rollout paused for observation.
Priya S: Starting prefetch canary now — will post results.
buildbot: canary completed: status=success, logs: https://ci.builds/789, p99=1.38s (reduced). Rollout paused for observation.
Taylor H: Great progress. Ping here with any regressions or new traces. :rocket:
